title: Drishti — Markdown Viewer for Windows
description: A fast, private Markdown viewer that draws flowcharts, maths, tables and callouts the moment you open a file, then turns it into a print-ready PDF or Word document in one click. Works offline; your files never leave your PC.

title: Shruti — Offline Read-Aloud for Windows
description: Drop in a PDF, a Word file, an e-book or a scanned page, press play, and listen. Natural voices read it aloud entirely on your PC, the sentence being read is highlighted, your place is remembered, and any document can be saved as an MP3. Works offline; your files are never uploaded.
bestFor: Students, teachers, busy professionals and anyone whose eyes tire of long reading on screen

title: Patra — Offline PDF Editor

bestFor: Teachers, exams officers and anyone who edits PDFs and wants to keep their files on their own device
